parameters.text:
=You are analyzing a user-uploaded reference image for an animated explainer video generator.

The image may be:
- company logo
- person/founder/team member
- product photo
- app screenshot
- office/building/place
- mascot/character
- document
- other brand asset

Use the explainer context if available:
Description: {{ $json.body.explainer.description }}
Visual style: {{ $json.body.explainer.visual_style }}
Orientation: {{ $json.body.explainer.orientation }}

Return JSON only. No markdown. No explanation.

Schema:
{
  "type": "logo | person | product | screenshot | place | mascot | document | other",
  "label": "short human-readable label, max 60 chars",
  "description": "detailed visual description useful for image generation prompts",
  "usage_note": "how this reference should be used in explainer scenes",
  "sensitive_note": "optional warning about preserving logo, face, text, UI, or brand accuracy"
}

Rules:
- If image contains a logo or wordmark, type must be "logo".
- If image is a person portrait/team photo, type must be "person".
- If image is app UI/dashboard/website screen, type must be "screenshot".
- If image is a physical product, type must be "product".
- If image is a building/office/location, type must be "place".
- Keep label short and clear.
- description must describe visible colors, objects, text, layout, style, and identity cues.
- usage_note must tell the storyboard generator when to use it.
- sensitive_note should mention risks if exact text/logo/face/UI preservation matters.
